name: tubeforge
description: The token-saving Claude Code setup from the TubeForge channel, as five installable plugins

plugins.name: token-guard
plugins.description: Hooks that format, lint-fix, type-check and test Claude's output before you see it

plugins.name: context-kit
plugins.description: Five MCP servers so Claude fetches context instead of you pasting it

plugins.name: review-crew
plugins.description: Five subagents with their own context windows: reviewer, tester, doc-writer, researcher, migrator

plugins.name: skill-pack
plugins.description: Five skills loaded on relevance instead of retyped every session

plugins.name: memory-kit
plugins.description: A /remember command that writes corrections into the right CLAUDE.md
